fact: In 2023, 241 Savannah Region facilities (80.1% CHPS) enrolled on the MCH e-Tracker; an average 64.3% consistently reported to DHIMS2 aggregate from paper-based registers, and e-Tracker use fell from 58.1% in June to 22.8% in December 2023.
title: Transitioning to digital transactional data capture in primary health care facilities: a case report from Ghana's Savannah Region
